The page covers the technical implementation of both channels, their protocols, authentication mechanisms, and how they are integrated in the TraeClient class. For the actual implementation details of specific protocols, see TowelTransport Protocol and REST API Protocol . For information about the target system components being communicated with, see Target System Components . For production client usage, see TraeClient - Production Client . Architecture Overview The Trae CN reverse-engineered client implements two parallel communication channels to interact with different components of the target system: REST API Channel : HTTPS-based communication with the cloud API at api.trae.com.cn IPC Channel : Unix domain socket communication with the local ai-agent process Sources: trae_client.py 334-533 trae_client.py 127-332 trae_client.py 535-593 The TraeClient class serves as the unified facade that can utilize either or both transport mechanisms depending on availability and configuration. REST API Communication Path Transport Implementation The REST API channel is implemented through the _RESTTransport class, which manages HTTP communication with the Trae CN cloud API. IPC Communication Path TowelTransport Protocol Implementation The IPC channel uses a custom protocol implementation called TowelTransportIPC , which communicates with the local ai-agent process through a Unix domain socket.
